Present a 12-month plan to the CTO: what gets automated, what AI goes where, what the HRMS needs, what the security baseline is and what it costs. Why this role • Unusual scope for your level: AI, systems, security and network across five companies and 2,000 people, reporting directly to the CTO. • Real problems with real users — your work shows up in how sites run and how fast we win tenders, not in a backlog. • The group is building toward an IPO in 2027.
